CustomField.description: The site's readable address name, unique across the org — the part of a public URL that replaces the 18-character record Id. Generated from the business name on first save and renameable from the hub's Domain card. Uniqueness is enforced by the platform here rather than by Apex, so two sites can never race into the same address. Not required: sites created before G1a have none, and resolution still accepts the record Id. See docs/url-contract.md.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The readable name used in this site's public web address. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
CustomField.label: Slug
